_approach: The Amapiano side of the hybrid pushed forward: tomLow+congaLow trade a bouncing, syncopated figure across the whole two bars in place of a bassline (the log drum 'creates the bass lines and momentum' per Splice's Amapiano piece), while the 3-step kick (beats 1, 2, 4, drop-3) stays underneath as the frame. NOTE: this approximates Amapiano's melodic log-drum bass rhythmically only - there is no pitched instrument here. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
